invalid/candidate-missing-schema-version.why: Every profile must state its schema version.

invalid/candidate-compensation-without-c.contains: closest cause at /jobPreferences/compensation/hardCondition/atLeast: 'currency' is a required property
invalid/candidate-compensation-without-c.why: A salary without currency is ambiguous.

invalid/job-compensation-without-period..contains: closest cause at /offer/compensation/0: 'period' is a required property
invalid/job-compensation-without-period..why: A salary without period (hour, month, year) is ambiguous.

invalid/job-estimated-salary-as-point-va.contains: closest cause at /offer/compensation/2: 'min' is a required property
invalid/job-estimated-salary-as-point-va.why: Estimates must be stated as an interval.

invalid/job-remote-share-without-referen.contains: closest cause at /offer/workModel/remoteShare: 'referencePeriod' is a required property
invalid/job-remote-share-without-referen.why: A remote share needs its reference period (week, month, year).

invalid/candidate-commute-distance-in-mi.why: Distance and travel time are different quantities; MIN is not a distance unit.

invalid/candidate-public-minimal-with-id.contains: False schema does not allow this value (keys: displayName)
invalid/candidate-public-minimal-with-id.why: A public minimal representation must not carry identity data.

invalid/job-domain-criterion-wrong-value.why: dataType BOOLEAN requires a boolean value.

invalid/job-domain-criterion-unstable-id.why: Domain criteria need a stable reverse-DNS identifier.

invalid/job-with-candidate-preferences.j.why: A JobProfile must not carry candidate-side fields.

invalid/candidate-evidenced-without-evid.why: An evidenced statement must point to its evidence.

invalid/candidate-wrong-type.json.why: Only AJMS document types are accepted.

invalid/candidate-hybrid-wish-without-wr.why: Preferences must say whether they are a hardCondition or a wish.

invalid-semantic/job-salary-min-greater-.why: Ranges must be ordered; JSON Schema cannot express this.

invalid-semantic/candidate-dangling-evid.why: Evidence references must resolve within the document.

invalid-semantic/candidate-ongoing-with-.contains: an ongoing entry must not have endMonth
